speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: For example, when a general practitioner (GP) applies for an account to the NEHR, the application will be subjected to MOH’s review and approval before access is granted.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Beyond that, any access to individual health records, such as for purposes of coroner’s investigation, will only be granted if it is enabled by the relevant legislation.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: Security penetration tests and independent cybersecurity audits are conducted regularly.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Mr Chee Hong Tat) (for the Minister for Health)
text: While measures have been put in place, we need to continue to remain vigilant.
